title: Psychology Study Platform
description: An interactive, AI-powered learning system with dynamic flashcards, intelligent quizzes, and smart study guide generation — designed for deep cognitive retention.

caseStudy.story: Built during late-night study sessions fueled by one question: What if studying psychology wasn't painful? Most digital study tools were static, repetitive, and cognitively flat. I wanted something that adapted to how humans actually learn.
caseStudy.problem: Traditional flashcards don't adapt to a student's current knowledge state. Students review what they already know, wasting time and losing retention. There was no intelligent study companion that understood context.
caseStudy.architecture: Integrated Claude AI API as an intelligent tutor layer. The system dynamically generates contextual flashcards, creates adaptive quizzes based on previous answer patterns, and produces personalized study guides. Built entirely with vanilla HTML/CSS/JS — proof that powerful AI experiences don't require heavy frameworks.
caseStudy.challenges: Optimizing API call latency while maintaining a smooth UX. Designing prompts that consistently produced structured, educationally valid output. Building an adaptive scoring system without a backend — using client-side state management exclusively.
caseStudy.impact: Transformed passive study into active AI-guided learning. Demonstrated that a single developer with AI tools can build what would traditionally require a full product team.
caseStudy.lessons: AI can transform passive consumption into active engagement. Prompt design is as critical as code design. Simplicity of stack ≠ simplicity of product.

title: Attendify — Attendance Platform
description: A highly organized web-based platform for structured attendance data tracking. Engineered with a clean UI to manage real-time attendance logistics seamlessly.

caseStudy.story: A problem I experienced firsthand every semester — no clean, fast way to track attendance across multiple subjects with different thresholds. Manual spreadsheets were fragile, app solutions were bloated. I built the tool I needed.
caseStudy.problem: Students need to maintain minimum attendance percentages (typically 75%) across 5–8 subjects simultaneously. No lightweight tool existed to track this, project future attendance, and alert when thresholds were at risk.
caseStudy.architecture: Built a web-based attendance tracking system with C++ core logic for attendance calculations, wrapped with a Node.js API layer and a clean JSON data store. The frontend provides a real-time dashboard showing each subject's current percentage, future projections, and 'safe to skip' calculations.
caseStudy.challenges: Integrating C++ core processing with Node.js async API handling. Keeping user state synced across browser restarts without authentication friction.
caseStudy.impact: Eliminated spreadsheet dependency for attendance tracking. Real-time percentage updates and future projections give students clear visibility of their academic standing.
caseStudy.lessons: The simplest ideas often create the most value. Build what you need — it will likely help others too. Bridging compiled languages with web UIs is powerful.

title: Continuity - Financial Sustainability Vault
description: Continuity is a secure digital legacy platform that brings wills, investments, assets, estates, and important documents into one trusted place—with controlled access for the people who matter most.

caseStudy.story: A secure digital legacy platform designed to bring wills, investments, assets, estates, and important documents together in one trusted place. Continuity focuses on making personal legacies organized, accessible, and securely shareable with the people who matter most.
caseStudy.problem: Important financial and legacy information is often scattered across documents, accounts, institutions, and personal records. Families may struggle to know what exists, where it is, or how to access it when it matters most.
caseStudy.architecture: Built a centralized digital platform that enables users to organize assets, investments, wills, estates, and critical documents, while providing secure, role-based access and family notifications for controlled information sharing.
caseStudy.challenges: Designing a system that balances accessibility with privacy and security. Creating a simple experience for managing complex financial and legacy information while ensuring that sensitive data is shared only with the right people.
caseStudy.impact: Created a unified digital space for managing personal legacy and financial information, helping individuals stay organized while giving trusted family members the right access when needed.
caseStudy.lessons: The best digital systems simplify complexity without compromising trust. Continuity was built around the idea that preserving a legacy is not just about storing information, but ensuring it reaches the right people at the right time.

title: WALL-E — Mental Health AI Companion App
description: A supportive AI companion for mood check-ins, guided journaling, and reflective conversations — designed to encourage healthier daily habits with clear, user-first boundaries.

caseStudy.story: WALL-E began with a simple idea: create a calm, private space where a person can pause, reflect, and build a more consistent emotional check-in habit.
caseStudy.problem: Daily stress is easy to overlook until it compounds. People need a low-friction way to capture how they feel, reflect on patterns, and find supportive prompts without replacing professional care.
caseStudy.architecture: Built as a responsive AI companion experience with guided check-ins, journal prompts, mood history, and contextual conversation flows. The product keeps personal reflection at the center and makes support resources easy to access when needed.
caseStudy.challenges: Designing language that feels supportive without making clinical claims, protecting the privacy of personal reflections, and making the experience clear about its limits.
caseStudy.impact: Created a gentler daily reflection experience that helps users notice patterns and make space for intentional self-care.
caseStudy.lessons: Empathy must shape every interaction. Mental-health-related tools need clear boundaries, privacy-first decisions, and easy access to professional support.
